description: This is a shell script file that tests the resilience of Git pack objects to corruption, including creating, corrupting, and recovering from pack object corruption scenarios. It defines functions for test setup, simulates corruption, and verifies recovery processes using Git commands and custom testing tools.

methods.name: create_test_files
methods.description: Creates test files with random data and adds specific labels for testing.

methods.name: create_new_pack
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository, creates objects from test files, and packs them into a pack file.

methods.name: do_repack
methods.description: Recreates the pack files, potentially with intentional corruption for testing recovery.

methods.name: do_corrupt_object
methods.description: Corrupts a specific object in the pack file by altering its data at a given offset.
